patch_description: Builds several low-cost shared multicast-tree candidates rather than committing to one greedy attachment order. It combines shortest-path routing with marginal-cost tree growth: already selected links have zero incremental cost, encouraging reuse and reducing duplicate cross-cloud transfers. Candidate trees are generated from different seed destinations and orderings, then the lowest total unique-edge-cost topology is selected. Each destination still receives the same partitioned path output format.
